name: High-Temperature Oxidation & Protective Coatings
summary: Studies how metals and ceramics react with hot gases and how coatings protect engine and rocket components.

topics.name: Thermodynamics of oxidation: Ellingham diagrams and oxide stability
Oxidation kinetics: linear, parabolic and logarithmic rate laws
Wagner theory of oxidation and defect structure of oxides
Protective scales: chromia, alumina and silica formers
Scale adhesion, spallation and reactive-element effects
Internal oxidation and selective oxidation of alloys
Hot corrosion, sulphidation and CMAS attack
Oxidation of refractory metals and carbon-carbon; active vs passive oxidation of SiC
Thermal barrier coatings: YSZ top coats, bond coats and failure by TGO growth
Environmental barrier coatings for SiC ceramics
Metal dusting and hydrogen/oxygen-rich rocket combustion environments
